knowledge_gaps: Residual calibration is underspecified: define the coefficient parameterization, cap, optimizer and logit scale. A sigmoid cannot initialize exactly at zero with finite parameters; some clamped parameterizations can prevent learning at zero.
Confidence shrinkage must survive scoring: use confidence × dot(normalized_pool, normalized_candidate). Taking cosine similarity after multiplying the pool by confidence would cancel the shrinkage.

Reproducibility requires tokenization, vocabulary limits, title/description weighting, K, recency units, tau, shrinkage, negative count, replacement policy, and checkpoint-selection rules. Define zero-text and fewer-than-two-distinct-item behavior explicitly.

Repeated lexical agreement does not necessarily identify specific interests. Boilerplate, brands and near-duplicate listings can create support across distinct item IDs; event recency also does not establish calendar freshness.

The proposed comparisons cannot isolate repeated support from generic text similarity or recency. Include a simple recent-text pool and remove support weighting and recency separately. The fixed-text version also removes the initial learned encoder and auxiliary objective, so conclusions must describe that narrower method.

Sparse causal pooling cost and diagnostic compatibility remain unresolved. Specify batching or caching without constructing dense catalog similarity matrices, and how log2feats/predict_score carry semantic state without mutable-cache errors.

No baseline validation HR@10, trial allocation, or uncertainty analysis is supplied. With only 200 validation users per category, extensive coefficient and checkpoint tuning risks selection overfitting. Originality 5 and potential 8 remain subjective; difficulty 4 may underestimate sparse computation and predictor integration.

follow_up_queries.reason: Resolve executable scoring, gradient behavior and computational feasibility before training.
follow_up_queries.query: For a SASRec extension with fixed sparse TF-IDF item vectors, causal recent-history pooling and score = ID_logit + alpha * confidence * dot(normalized_pool, normalized_candidate), what efficient sparse implementations and bounded nonnegative coefficient parameterizations permit learning from alpha=0? Explain why cosine normalization cancels confidence scaling and how to avoid dense catalog similarity matrices.

follow_up_queries.reason: Assess novelty and whether repeated lexical support improves relevance rather than reinforcing metadata shortcuts.
follow_up_queries.query: What prior work studies TF-IDF content residuals or repeated-interest semantic pooling in sequential recommendation, and what evidence addresses brand, boilerplate and near-duplicate shortcuts? Identify ablations comparing recent-text pooling, recency weighting, distinct-item agreement and support shrinkage using interaction histories and titles/descriptions only, without pretrained representations.

follow_up_queries.reason: Make model selection credible within the fixed benchmark and search budget.
follow_up_queries.query: For sequential recommendation evaluated with 200 fixed validation users in each of four datasets and 99 unique sampled negatives per user, what methods quantify uncertainty in paired macro HR@10 differences and reduce adaptive hyperparameter-selection overfitting? Describe paired user bootstrap limitations, per-dataset reporting and budgeted ablation design when training seed=42, evaluation seed=42 and total search budget is 43,200 GPU-seconds.
